item.title: Montenegro at 20: After breaking with Serbia and joining NATO, EU is the next frontier
item.description: Montenegro marks 20 years of independence from a union with Serbia this week, celebrating a two-decade transformation that has already brought the Balkan country into NATO

item.title: This hard-line Iranian general is a major player in talks with US over war
item.description: A hard-line Iranian general linked to notorious attacks at home and abroad is believed to have seized a place near the center of power as negotiations with the United States hang in the balance

item.title: UK offers cheaper chocolate and tickets to the zoo in bid to ease cost of living squeeze
item.description: The British government is offering cheaper chocolate and discounted theme park entry to ease the cost-of-living squeeze triggered by the Iran war

item.title: A displaced Lebanese grandmother feeds thousands of compatriots who fled war
item.description: Soubhiye Zeiter started baking outside her tent in Beirut to feed herself and her family, displaced by war

item.title: Philippine justice chief orders arrest of senator wanted by the ICC over Duterte-era killings
item.description: The Philippines justice chief has ordered the enforcement of an International Criminal Court warrant for a senator wanted on an alleged crime against humanity charge
